profile.headline: Engineering leader builds high quality cloud solutions at enterprise scale.
profile.summary: Specialties: C#, Python, Web Development, SQL, Automation Testing, Server Testing, UI Tesing, Internationalization Testing.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Recruit and coach talents to build a team of 4 software engineers.
- Eliminate repeating operation cost to support new customers by building scalable data pipelines and services.
- Enable team to engage and focus on innovations by defining technical roadmap.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led design and implementation across teams to build distributed data pipeline infrastructure with Apache Spark, Apache Hive and AWS RDS MySQL in data platform.
- Removed manual operation cost of ETL workflows by building robust workflow management system in Python to automate 200+ workflows running in AWS Batch per day.
- Built Java microservices to provide APIs of membership to serve over 1M members.
- Increased efficiency to investigate data anomalies by providing better processes and tools.
- Set technical roadmaps and key results for team by working with senior leaders and technical project manager.
- Raised the bar of code quality by mentoring engineers to adopt good engineering practices.

positions.title: Software Development Team Lead
positions.description:
- Managed and coached a team of 5 - 6 software engineers.
- Motivated and built team by setting clear team goals and recruiting top talents.
- Empowered team to build cloud-base content management system for 60K+ hotel websites by defining product roadmap with product owners and UX designers.
- Modernized partner facing system by migrating backend services to a more scalable architecture with RESTful APIs.
- Increased product deployment frequency 100% by leading cross-team efforts to transform development cycle from mini waterfall to Agile.
- Invented monitoring and tracking system to visualize all code changes, ticket status, and test results in real time by using Python Django and AngularJS.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Built and managed team of 5 software engineers in test across distributed locations by hiring, coaching and managing team goals.
- Grew software test and quality cultures across engineering teams by defining test strategies and advocating software quality engineering best practices.
- Designed product features and issues management processes from scratch.
- Created efficient test automation by architecting C# and Python test infrastructure for APIs and web testing with Selenium Grid.
- Enabled continuous integration (CI) in product group by building and managing Jenkins processes.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Defined test strategies and implemented test automation in C# for content management system of WindowsPhone.com and business intelligence system of Windows Phone business metrics.
- Improved internationalization (i18n) quality of Windows Phone services and Visual Studio by leading virtual SDET teams across the division.
- Managed onsite and offshore software testing vendors.
